non_compete_clause_apply.title: Apply a non-compete clause?

helpCenter.content:
What do I need to know?

Courts analyze non-compete clauses on a case-by-case basis. They take into account their scope (substantive and geographical) and duration. Courts will not enforce a non-compete clause unless they are reasonable and no more than necessary to protect a legitimate aim of the company.

Enforceability depends on a variety of factors. These factors include the employee's level of impact within the business and their influence over clients. Additionally, non-compete clauses through employers of record (EOR) have not been tested in courts. So we cannot guarantee that it will be enforced.
helpCenter.title: Non-compete clause
